note: Tier 2, vendor-documented, not captured here: OpenAI Chat Completions (gpt-5, OpenAI direct) rejecting frequency_penalty on a reasoning model, as reported by a third party at https://github.com/oracle/ai-optimizer/issues/240. The report prints the documented {error: {message, type, param, code}} envelope as a Python dict; the body is that envelope re-serialized compactly as JSON. lifted_type is the error.type routectl lifts from the body.
body: {"error":{"message":"Unsupported parameter: 'frequency_penalty' is not supported with this model.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"frequency_penalty","code":"unsupported_parameter"}}
